package.name: controller_dissipative
package.description: Decentralized dissipative virtual-node spring-damper reference generator for a cable-suspended load, ported from Quan et al., "Self-Organizing Aerial Swarm Robotics: A Table-Mechanics-Inspired Approach". A robot can detach mid-flight (n -> n-1) and the remaining fleet re-settles with the load suspended, with no solver switch. Publishes the same per-drone reference wire format as the centralized OCP (controller_load_mpc), so the per-drone trackers are unchanged. Depends on controller_load_mpc only for stateless shared helpers (geometry, load_trajectory, creep_controller) -- no OCP/acados import.
